200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully created the cloud connector.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
Array of objects
connector
connector
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to create a cloud connector.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
